Overview

RTV Implementation
Web Platform

The Implementation web platform is the office-facing complement to the mobile app. Built in React and TypeScript, it provides comprehensive dashboards, detailed programme analytics, data management, and administrative control for Project Officers, Project Managers, and Administrators.

What the Web Platform Does

Programme Analytics
Live dashboards across all modules — Agriculture, VSLA, VSF, Livestock, Check-ins, Trainings, and Workplans.
VSF Approval
Officer review and Manager approval of Village Savings Fund loan applications.
Leadership Management
Register and manage all eight champion types across villages and clusters.
Workplan Tracking
District and national-level workplan creation, progress monitoring, and performance tracking.
WorkMate AI
AI assistant trained on programme data for instant field team support.
User Administration
Create, edit, and manage accounts across all roles. Assign districts and clusters.
Data Export
Export reports as CSV or Excel across all modules for offline analysis.
Settings
Programme configuration, financial thresholds, and system-wide parameters.

Tech Stack

Framework
React 18 with TypeScript — component-based architecture with strict type safety.
State Management
Redux Toolkit with RTK Query — server state managed via auto-generated API hooks with caching and optimistic updates.
UI Components
Ant Design component library styled with SASS theme overrides using RTV brand tokens.
Charts
ApexCharts for all analytical visualisations — bar, line, pie, donut, and area charts.
Routing
React Router with role-based route guards — pages are protected at the component level based on the authenticated user's role.
Getting Started

Authentication

Access the web platform through your organisation's designated URL. Authentication is role-based — the platform loads a different layout and module set depending on your assigned role.

Logging In

1
Open the platform URL
Use a modern browser (Chrome, Edge, or Firefox recommended). Navigate to the RTV Implementation platform URL provided by your organisation.
2
Choose your login method
Select Login with Email or Login with Phone Number — both use the same account. Enter your credentials and click Sign In.
3
Role-based redirect
After authentication, the platform redirects you to your role's default landing page. The sidebar and available modules reflect your permissions.
—
Session persistence
The session remains active for an extended period. If it expires, you are redirected to the login page automatically.

Password Reset

Click Forgot Password on the login screen. Enter your email address — a reset link is sent to that address.

—
Browser compatibility
The platform requires a browser released after 2020. Internet Explorer is not supported.
Getting Started

Navigation

The platform uses a persistent left sidebar for primary navigation, a top header for global actions, and breadcrumbs within each module for sub-navigation. Most data tables support filtering, sorting, and search.

Home Dashboard

After logging in you land on the Home dashboard — a role-scoped summary of programme activity. Quick-action buttons give direct access to the most-used reports and views.

Top Header Controls

Notifications bell
Shows pending items requiring your attention — new VSF applications for review or approval, workplan deadlines, and system alerts.
User avatar / menu
Access your profile, language settings, and logout from the top-right dropdown.
Profiles filter
Scopes all dashboard data to a specific District, Cluster, and Village. Changes apply platform-wide until you clear the filter.
Breadcrumb trail
Appears below the header within modules — shows your current location and lets you jump up to a parent page quickly.

Common Table Controls

  • Search bar: Full-text search across visible columns, with a short debounce.
  • Column sort: Click any column header to sort ascending; click again for descending.
  • Date range filter: Select start and end dates to narrow records.
  • District / Cluster filter: Dropdown selectors filter records to a geographic area.
  • Export: Exports the currently filtered data set as CSV or Excel.
  • Pagination: 10, 25, or 50 records per page — select from the page-size dropdown.
Getting Started

Roles & Permissions

Three roles access the web platform. A fourth role — Champion — uses only the mobile app for VSF and VSLA tasks.

Admin
Unrestricted access across all modules, all districts, and all administrative functions. Can manage user accounts, configure system settings, view all reports, approve any submission, and export all data.
Project Manager
Full access to assigned districts. Manages VSF final approvals, views district analytics, oversees workplans, and monitors team performance. Cannot create or modify user accounts.
Project Officer
Access to assigned district data. Reviews and forwards VSF applications, monitors field team submissions, manages workplans for their district, and accesses training and check-in reports.
—
Data scope
All roles see only data within their assigned geography. Admins see all data.
Module

Agriculture

The Agriculture module provides programme-wide visibility into seed distribution, nursery bed activity, tool distribution, and agricultural input inventories.

—
Available to
Project OfficerManagerAdmin

Dashboard

Distribution Overview
Total seed and tool distributions completed, displayed as KPI tiles with trend arrows comparing to the previous period.
Coverage by District
Bar chart showing villages reached per district — quickly identifies gaps in geographic coverage.
Seed Type Breakdown
Donut chart of quantities distributed by seed variety (Maize, Bean, Rice, Sorghum, Millet, Groundnut, Soybean, Vegetable).
Pass-on Trend
Line chart showing seed pass-on activity, with a secondary line for seed returns — tracks programme recycling effectiveness.
Inventory Status
Table of all tracked storage locations with current stock levels, minimum thresholds, and colour-coded status.

Reports

  • Household Seed Distributions — filterable by date, district, cluster, village, seed type, and target group
  • Village Seed Distributions — bulk distributions with aggregated quantity and village coverage data
  • Nursery Bed Distributions — expected seedling count and transplant schedule
  • Seedling Transplants — survival rate tracking per nursery batch
  • Agriculture Tools Distribution — tool type, quantity, and condition breakdown
  • Seed Returns — condition and disposal method analysis
  • Seed Pass-ons — household-to-household flow analysis
Module

VSLA

The VSLA module gives Officers and Managers a comprehensive view of Village Savings and Loan Association performance — group health, savings growth, loan cycles, and member participation — aggregated across assigned districts.

—
Available to
Project OfficerManagerAdmin

Dashboard

Group Count
Active VSLA groups across all monitored districts. Trend indicator shows groups formed vs. dissolved this period.
Total Savings
Aggregate savings held across all groups, with a district-level breakdown bar chart.
Loan Portfolio
Total outstanding loans, average loan size, and repayment rate — displayed as KPI tiles.
Meeting Compliance
Percentage of groups that held meetings on schedule in the period, broken down by cluster.
Financial Literacy Coverage
Proportion of groups that have completed each financial literacy training topic.

Groups & Members

The Groups table lists every registered VSLA group. Click any group to view its full activity history — all recorded meetings, loans, savings, and member records.

The Members tab shows every individual registered in a VSLA group — their role (Member / Chairperson / Secretary / Treasurer), savings balance, outstanding loan amount, and participation status.

Savings & Initiatives

A transaction ledger view covers every savings entry across all groups. The Initiatives sub-module records IGA projects linked to VSLA groups — project type, funding amount, status, and outcome.

Module

VSF — Village Savings Fund

The Village Savings Fund web module is the primary workspace for Officers reviewing loan applications and Managers approving or rejecting them. The web interface provides a richer review environment than the mobile app, with full application history, grouped payments, and portfolio analytics.

—
Available to
Project Officer (review)  Manager (approve)  Admin (all)

Loan Application Workflow

Status TabWho ActsAvailable Actions
Pending ReviewProject OfficerAdd Comment · Forward for Approval
Pending ApprovalProject ManagerApprove Loan · Reject Loan
ApprovedRead-onlyView details and disbursement record
RejectedRead-onlyView rejection reason and full history

Reviewing an Application (Officer)

1
Open the Pending Review tab
Click any row to open the application detail — VSLA group info, loan type, principal, growth fee, repayment schedule, and Champion's monitoring reports.
2
Verify the figures
Confirm principal and growth fee fall within programme policy limits. Check the VSLA group's current savings balance and loan history.
3
Forward for approval
Click Submit for Approval. The application moves to Pending Approval and appears in the Manager's queue. The Champion receives a notification.

Approving or Rejecting an Application (Manager)

1
Open from Pending Approval
Review the full application history including the Officer's comment.
2
Approve or Reject
Click Approve to authorise disbursement, or Reject with a mandatory, specific reason. The Champion and Officer are notified immediately.
—
Rejection reasons are mandatory
Enter a specific, actionable explanation — the field team relies on this to correct and resubmit the application.
Module

Livestock

Programme-wide view of animal distributions, follow-up monitoring, and pass-on tracking. Officers use it to monitor herd health and verify the programme's multiplication model is working in the field.

—
Available to
Project OfficerManagerAdmin

Dashboard

Distribution Summary
Total animals distributed by type (Cattle, Goats, Sheep, Pigs, Chickens, Ducks, Guinea Pigs) with period comparison.
Follow-up Coverage
Percentage of households that have received at least one monitoring visit since distribution. Identifies households overdue for a follow-up.
Pass-on Progress
Completed pass-ons vs. pass-ons due based on programme agreements. Trend line over time.
Health Status
Proportion of followed-up animals assessed as Healthy, Moderately Healthy, or Unhealthy. Alerts for clusters with high proportions of unhealthy animals.

Records

Three tables — Distribution Records, Follow-up Records, and Pass-on Records — each filterable by district, cluster, animal type, and date. Use Follow-up Records filtered by "no follow-up yet" to generate a targeted visit list for field teams.

Module

Leadership & Champions

Manages all community champion roles within the programme. Eight champion types serve different functions at village and household level. Officers register champions, assign them to villages, and monitor their performance here.

—
Available to
Project OfficerManagerAdmin

Champion Types

Champion TypeDomainAllocation Logic
Village ChampionOverall village leadership1 per village (<120 HH); 2 (120–299 HH); 3 (300+ HH)
Community ChampionAgriculture & Livestock1 per 20 HH (minimum 15 HH per champion)
VSLA ChampionVillage Savings and Loan Associations1 per VSLA group
VSF ChampionVillage Savings Fund applications1 per assigned VSLA group
Hygiene ChampionWASH and sanitation1 per 20 HH
Coffee ChampionCoffee cultivation programme1 per village in coffee programme areas
Livestock ChampionLivestock follow-up and pass-ons1 per 20 livestock households
Community MobiliserCommunity engagement and mobilisation1 per cluster

Registering a Champion

1
Navigate to Leadership
Click Leadership in the sidebar, then select the champion type from the sub-menu.
2
Click Add Champion
Fill in: full name, national ID, date of birth, gender, phone number, district, cluster, and village assignment. For VSLA and VSF Champions, also select the assigned VSLA group.
3
Set status and save
New registrations default to Active. Click Save Champion — the champion appears in the village's leadership roster immediately.
Module

Check-ins

Aggregates all household and community compliance visits from the mobile app. Officers and Managers use it to monitor field team activity, review compliance scores, and identify villages or districts that need intervention.

—
Available to
Project OfficerManagerAdmin

Dashboard

Completion Rate
Scheduled vs. completed check-ins in the period, as a percentage and absolute count.
Average Compliance Scores
Programme-wide average for each domain: WASH, Agriculture, Livestock, VSLA. Colour-coded by band.
Geographic Heatmap
Village-level compliance visualisation — darker shade indicates higher compliance.
Officer Activity
Check-in submission count per officer in the period — identifies officers behind on their visit schedule.
Household Status Breakdown
Count of households by status (Active / Temporarily Absent / Migrated / Inactive) — monitors programme attrition.

Check-in Records

Full table of all submitted check-ins — date, household, village, officer, check-in type, and overall compliance score. Click any row to see the full assessment detail including domain scores and photos.

Household Status Management

On the household detail page, authorised users can update household status. Changing a status to Migrated or Inactive removes the household from the active visit schedule.

Module

SBCC Coaching

The SBCC Coaching module aggregates all household coaching sessions submitted via the mobile app. Officers and Managers can review coaching session outcomes, barrier analysis patterns, and AI message effectiveness across their districts.

—
Available to
Project OfficerManagerAdmin

Dashboard

Sessions Completed
Total household coaching sessions submitted in the period, broken down by thematic area (Agriculture, WASH, Livestock).
Barrier Distribution
Most frequently selected barriers across all coaching sessions — identifies the systemic constraints most limiting programme adoption.
Message Rating
Proportion of AI-generated messages rated positively (thumbs up) vs. negatively (thumbs down) by field staff — a proxy for message quality and relevance.
Coverage
Number of households that have received at least one coaching session in the period, by village.

—
Available to
Project OfficerManagerAdmin

Dashboard

Sessions Completed
Total training sessions in the period with a trend line vs. the previous period.
Average Attendance

Module

Workplans

The planning and accountability layer of the platform. Officers create activity workplans for their districts, log progress against planned activities, and Managers review performance against targets.

—
Available to
Project OfficerManagerAdmin

Creating a Workplan

1
Click Add Workplan
Select the planning period (Monthly, Quarterly, or Custom date range) and district scope.
2
Define activities
Add rows for each planned activity: type, target count, target villages, responsible officer, and planned completion date.
3
Set targets and publish
Enter numeric targets for trainings, check-ins, distributions, and follow-up visits. Click Publish to make it visible to the full team.

Monitoring Progress

Progress bars are automatically calculated from field submissions matching the activity type and geographic scope — no manual update needed. Status indicators:

On Track
Green — at or above the expected completion rate for the current date.
At Risk
Amber — below the expected rate but above 70%.
Behind
Red — significantly behind schedule, below 70% of expected completion.
Module

Community Cards

The Community Cards module tracks RTV Community Card distributions and their activation status across all villages. It gives Officers and Managers visibility into card issuance progress and helps identify households that still need cards for QR-based attendance.

—
Available to
Project OfficerManagerAdmin

Active Cards

Lists all households that have been issued an active Community Card. Filter by district, cluster, or village to check issuance progress in a specific area. The table shows card status, activation method, and the date the card was issued.

Inactive Cards

Lists cards with status Damaged, Lost, Temporary, or Replacement Pending. Use this view to prioritise replacement issuance and ensure households are not excluded from QR attendance tracking at trainings and check-ins.

AI Tools

WorkMate AI

WorkMate is an AI assistant built into the web platform, trained on programme data, field guides, and RTV knowledge resources. Field teams can ask questions in plain language and receive contextual, accurate answers.

—
Available to
Project AssistantProject OfficerManagerAdmin

Using WorkMate

1
Open WorkMate
Click WorkMate in the sidebar. A chat interface opens, available from any page in the platform.
2
Type your question
Ask in plain language — English or local language. Examples: "What is the minimum latrine standard for compliance?", "How many VSLA groups are in Kirehe this month?", "What should I check during a cattle follow-up visit?"
3
Review and follow up
WorkMate returns a structured answer with source references where applicable. Ask follow-up questions in the same thread — context is maintained for the duration of the session.

What WorkMate Knows

  • Programme standards and compliance requirements (WASH, Agriculture, Livestock)
  • VSLA and VSF procedures and policies
  • Champion types, responsibilities, and allocation rules
  • Field form guidance — how to complete each form correctly
  • Troubleshooting guidance for the mobile app
  • Programme data within your role's geographic scope (read-only summary queries)
—
Best results
Ask specific questions. "What are the compost maturity criteria for the agriculture check-in?" returns a more useful answer than "Tell me about agriculture."
Administration

User Management

User management is an Administrator-only function. Admins create accounts, set roles, assign geographic areas, and deactivate users.

—
Available to
Admin only

Creating a User

1
Navigate to Settings > User Management
Click Add User.
2
Enter user details
Full name, email address, phone number, and role selection.
3
Assign geographic scope
Select the districts this user can access. For Officers and PAs, also assign specific clusters. The user will only see data within their assigned area.
4
Send credentials
Click Create Account. The system sends a welcome email with a temporary password — the user must change it on first login.
—
Role changes
Changing a user's role takes effect immediately on both the web platform and mobile app. Downgrading removes access — data created under the previous role is preserved.

Available to
Admin only — some read-only views available to Managers
Administrative Units
Geographic hierarchy management — Regions, Districts, Clusters, and Villages. Changes propagate to all form dropdowns and dashboard filters.
Households
The central household registry. Manage household status (Active / Temporarily Absent / Migrated / Inactive), update household head details, and view programme participation history.

Support

Reference

Reports & Data Export

Every major data view on the platform supports export. Exports respect the active filters — always apply filters before exporting to avoid downloading the full dataset.

Export Formats

Excel (.xlsx)
Default format. Includes column headers, formatted data, and conditional formatting on status fields. Use for analysis in Excel or Google Sheets.
CSV (.csv)
Plain comma-delimited format. Use for importing into statistical software (R, STATA, SPSS) or data warehouses.

Scheduled Reports

Administrators can configure scheduled reports that automatically email a filtered dataset on a weekly or monthly schedule. Navigate to Settings > Scheduled Reports to set up a new schedule.

—
Large exports
Exports above 10,000 rows are processed asynchronously — you receive an email with a download link when the file is ready.
